notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines the trade arc: initiate/begin/busy/ignore/accept/unaccept/cancel plus set/clear item and set gold, SMSG_TRADE_STATUS with its 0..22 code vocabulary and per-code tails, and the 444-byte SMSG_TRADE_STATUS_EXTENDED per-side snapshot. MSUI implements the core verbs and both parses (slot-indexed 61-byte records, 7 slots, signed-charge skip), but drops the decline verbs and most of the status vocabulary.
